HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

2. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

   D. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

10. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru
